gigapan.description: This is a SEM Nano Gigapan of 4 different types of sweeteners, the image is composed of 198 pictures and the sweeteners are magnified 600x.   From left to right the sweeteners are Equal (dextrose, maltodextrin, and aspartame), Splenda (dextrose, maltodextrin, and sucralose), Sugar in the raw, and regular table sugar.
